test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an INCORRECT statement concerning public goods?

options.text: Usually, public goods are provided by the government.
Consumption of public goods by people is rivalrous in nature.
It is not easy to collect fees for public goods from every individual.
Public goods are non-excludable in nature.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Consumption of public goods by people is rivalrous in nature.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Public goods are goods or services that are non-excludable and non-rivalrous in nature.**
 
• Non-excludable means that it is difficult or impossible to exclude someone from using the good or service once it is provided.
 
• Non-rivalrous means that one person's use of the good or service does not diminish its availability for others.
 
• Usually, public goods are provided by the government.
 
 
• This statement is generally true, as governments often provide public goods due to their non-excludable and non-rivalrous nature.
 
 
 
• Consumption of public goods by people is rivalrous in nature.
 
 
• This statement is incorrect, as the consumption of public goods is non-rivalrous in nature.
 
 
 
• It is not easy to collect fees for public goods from every individual.
 
 
• This statement is true, as it is difficult to exclude individuals from using public goods and therefore difficult to collect fees from every individual.
 
 
 
• Public goods are non-excludable in nature.
